mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_report (report_date, health_record_count, high_risk_count, fraud_block_count, order_count, summary, create_time) VALUES (#{reportDate}, #{healthRecordCount}, #{highRiskCount}, #{fraudBlockCount}, #{orderCount}, #{summary}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_report SET health_record_count = #{healthRecordCount}, high_risk_count = #{highRiskCount}, fraud_block_count = #{fraudBlockCount}, order_count = #{orderCount}, summary = #{summary} WHERE id = #{id}
